document_statuses.description: Document is under preparation, pending review or stakeholder approval, and is not considered authoritative.

rag_retrieval_rules.search_behavior: Excluded from default production RAG queries. Only retrievable when explicitly queried with include_drafts=true by document authors or administrators.

document_statuses.description: Current authoritative document officially approved and enforced across Threshold Enterprise Systems.

rag_retrieval_rules.search_behavior: Highest retrieval priority for all production semantic search, hybrid retrieval, and knowledge grounding pipelines.

document_statuses.description: Historical document retained for compliance, audit trails, and institutional memory, but no longer actively enforced or authoritative.

rag_retrieval_rules.search_behavior: Deprioritized relative to ACTIVE documents. Filtered or down-weighted in standard retrieval, retrievable during historical audit or compliance searches.

document_statuses.description: Document replaced by a newer version or newer policy. Retained for version diffing, audit history, and provenance tracing.

rag_retrieval_rules.search_behavior: Lowest retrieval weight. Whenever matching queries occur, retrieval systems must link to or prefer the superseding ACTIVE document version.
